protocol: 20 new simple synthetic business scenarios, three correlated formats each (TXT, single-column text PDF, two-column ruled PDF). Literal gold fixed before predictions. Not public originals, independent customer holdout, OCR testing, or production certification. No production normalizer generated gold. All output facts including unexpected ones scored.
execution: Existing native engine, no Docling, no OCR/VLM, no remote inference, 2 workers / inherited 4 logical CPUs / BelowNormal; no production edits.

root_causes.finding: Ordinary English unit names Volts, grams and watts are absent from the unit alias registry; source parsing and scope recognition succeed, normalization fails closed.
Open-field extraction requires a label/value separator or structured table binding. Value-first plain lines have neither; a table containing the same facts passes.

limits: Synthetic inputs; not representative population accuracy, independent human acceptance, or new supplier originals.
Three formats of the same scenario are correlated. Only 20 business scenarios / 73 distinct logical facts.
One true-conflict scenario repeated in three formats does not establish broad conflict recall.
9 oracle scope errors in 3 logical scenarios were adjudicated after seeing first predictions, preserved separately.
No scans, difficult layouts, cross-page notes, charts, version changes, or manual-edit UX were tested.
No production code was changed or GitHub pushed. This is measurement and root-cause reporting only.
